en: "Link Boost"{SAUT}Teammates can provide assistance through{SAUT}a {f 0 1 2}Link Boost{f 0 1 0}, which is activated when{SAUT}someone hits an enemy and the affinity of{SAUT}the attack is one the enemy is weak against.
The Link Boost makes the next acting{SAUT}party member gain two effects.
Continue attacking enemy weaknesses on{SAUT}the same turn, and you'll be given more{SAUT}and more Link Boost effects to choose from!
